get.description: Who the player faces and how it goes: the searchable opponent list that opens a Scouting Report (GET /api/v1/opponents/{opponent_id}), the W/D/L record against repeat opponents, W/D/L by opponent-rating-difference bucket, and outcome vs opponent rating. Every chart honors the global filters and the lens. Forfeits never count in records, buckets, or the scatter (a no-show win is not a win over an opponent).

OpponentsPayload.description: The Opponents screen. Source: pages/opponents.py layout + update_scout_options -> components.opponent_options (the picker, unfiltered); update_opponents -> pgn_stats_core.opponent_summary; update_bucket -> pgn_stats_core.opponent_rating_bucket_summary; update_scatter -> pgn_stats_core.outcome_vs_rating_data.

opponents.description: The Scouting Report picker: every named opponent in the whole archive, sorted by name. Deliberately unfiltered, like the web dropdown, so any opponent is searchable; the report itself honors the filters. Searching is client-side.

records.description: W/D/L against opponents played more than once, most Games first (ties: most wins first), capped at the top 25 like the web chart. Empty shows 'No repeat opponents in current filter'.

rating_buckets.description: W/D/L by opponent rating minus the player's rating, in bucket order (weakest opponents first). Only buckets holding a Game appear. Games where either rating is unknown are left out. Empty shows 'Need rated games'.

outcome_vs_rating.description: Scatter of outcome against opponent rating, one point per rated Game. Empty shows 'Need rated games'.

opponent_id.description: Opaque opponent ID (schema OpponentId, defined with GET /api/v1/opponents/{opponent_id}); pass it to that route.

opponent.description: The Opponent name as the Chapters spell it.

OpponentsRecord.description: One stacked horizontal bar: the player's W/D/L against one repeat opponent. The bar hover reads the count per outcome.

opponent_id.description: Opaque opponent ID (schema OpponentId), so a bar can open the Scouting Report. Null for Games with a blank Opponent name, which have no ID.

OpponentsRatingBucket.description: One stacked bar: W/D/L against opponents in one rating-difference bucket (opponent rating minus the player's, lens-aware). Positive means a stronger opponent.

bucket.description: The web's bucket label, verbatim (with the Unicode minus sign U+2212). Lower bounds are inclusive.

OpponentsOutcomePoint.description: One scatter point. x is opponent_rating, y is outcome_value (ticks Loss/Draw/Win), color is outcome; the hover reads the rating, the opponent, and the date.

opponent_rating.description: Their rating in that Game (lens-aware). Never null here: unrated Games are left out.

outcome_value.description: 1 for a Win, 0.5 for a Draw, 0 for a Loss.
